description: This file defines data structures, enums, and function prototypes related to Background DFS (Dynamic Frequency Selection) management in a wireless system. It includes configuration, status, and statistics for background DFS operations, as well as functions to control and query DFS states.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_setAvailable
methods.description: Update the background DFS feature availability for a given radio.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_notifyClearStarted
methods.description: Notify that a background DFS clear operation has started with specified channel, bandwidth, and type.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_notifyClearEnded
methods.description: Notify that a background DFS clear operation has ended with a specified result.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_startExt
methods.description: Start an external background DFS operation with given parameters.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_clearTimeEllapsed
methods.description: Return the elapsed time of the current clear operation.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_isRunning
methods.description: Check if a background DFS clear operation is currently active on the given radio.

methods.name: wld_bgdfs_update
methods.description: Synchronize the datamodel object with local DFS state values.
